settings.label: Logotype
settings.info: White-on-transparent PNG. The header inverts it, so supply the dark version.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.default: Cooked, not de-alcoholised. Fruit, tannin, salt and acid, built from zero at 0.0%.

settings.content: The somm, the shop filter and the pairing tool identify bottles by code (NON1, NON2, …). The code is read from the product metafield custom.non_code, falling back to the SKU, then to the handle. Set the metafield on each product and nothing else needs configuring.

settings.label: Core range collection
settings.info: Drives the homepage range grid and the somm's pick list.

settings.label: Somm API endpoint
settings.info: Cloudflare Worker URL. Accepts POST {query, context, page} and returns {answer, picks:[code]}. Leave blank to use the built-in canned answers from the design.

settings.label: Stream the answer
settings.info: Types the response character by character. Turn off if the endpoint returns SSE and you handle streaming natively.

settings.content: Discount codes are issued by the API, never generated in the browser. Without an endpoint the widget runs in demo mode and shows no code.

settings.label: Lotto API endpoint
settings.info: Cloudflare Worker URL. POST /draw returns {ref, prize:{title, code, terms}}; POST /claim takes {ref, email}.

settings.label: Open a drawer on add to cart

settings.content: Free shipping thresholds are per market and live in snippets/free-shipping.liquid. There is deliberately no single field here — one global number was previously shown to all five markets, including the UK, where the real threshold is different.
Offered in the cart drawer. Anything already in the cart is hidden automatically.
